title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
【恭喜宿主让藤藤蛇的愉悦值从10%提升到30%，奖励金坷垃十袋，神奇糖果一枚。特鳞果（能够永久有效提高宝可梦的特攻。）】“好吃吗？”见它身上散发的喜悦情绪，听着系统的播报声，林枫明知故问。“藤藤.....”藤藤蛇明亮的眼睛更加亮了，头立马快速的点了起来，可又觉得好像太过于明显了，降低点头的频率，还闭上了眼睛。“喜欢吃就好，除完草之前，我会一直提供这样的能量方块的。”见着这样的藤藤蛇，林枫心中也不由得乐了起来。这家伙，明明喜欢吃的不行，却还要故作矜持...微微低垂着的头，有些躲闪的橙色眸子....这模样.....实在是...有点可爱？“那这样吧，在除草期间，你的食物就是这种能量方块了。”“藤藤？”藤藤蛇看向放在地上的能量方块，又看向已经拔完一块地的杂草，手上的动作一下子就慢了起来。拔完草，就没有能量方块了？可是...这些草，它一天就能拔完呀！不行，要慢一点...不然怎么待久一点？这样想着，它连吃能量方块的速度都变慢了起来。足足耗了半个小时，这才吃完，然后投身于拔草事业当中，只是这一次拔草的效率....林枫看了都有些想笑，但还是为它辩护道：“如果你想练习拔草的话，其实你可以用藤鞭来拔草的，这样，能让你对身上的鞭子掌握的更加熟练。”“比如，藤鞭施展的力度和精准度，都能在这样的训练中变强。”他可不是胡说。拥有神级培育知识的他，设置出来的训练方法，是非常有效果的。“藤藤？”藤藤蛇站起身来，明亮的眼睛看向林枫，止不住的点了点头。这个人类好聪明！居然能想到这样的办法！“藤藤~”

（有道理~）不仅能训练藤鞭，还能让自己拔草的速度变慢！它的两根藤鞭开始向着旁边的地面上伸展而去，“嘿...”林枫见状，不由得笑了起来，也开始拔起草来，他要在今天整理出一块地来，至少，得种下一点紧急的种植物，比如配置成好伤药的种植物，还有一些能配制简单能量方块的产物。他拔草的速度很快，仅仅只是十来分钟，就已经拔完了差不多这块地的二分之一。“藤藤...”这可把旁边的藤藤蛇急得不行，你别拔这么快了呀！慢点~拔这么快，我岂不是吃不到能量方块了？可林枫仍然是我行我素的继续拔着，很快，第一块地，就陷入了尾声，上面的杂草就薅的干干净净。剩下的，就只需要借助穿山鼠那孩子，将整块地犁一下就能种植了。“藤藤...”这个时候，藤藤蛇用藤鞭抓住了他的裤脚。“怎么了？藤藤蛇？”林枫好奇的转过身来。“藤藤...藤藤~”（这..拔草...是我吃了你的桃桃果，所以，这....应该是我做的才对...）它的话语有些七零八落，但他还是听懂了其中的意思。大概就是，这是我的工作，不需要你干。“得...”林枫哑然失笑，蹲下身子，跟仅仅才80厘米的藤藤蛇平视，下意识的想将手放在它的头上，却被后者轻巧的躲开。林枫也不恼，“行，那你好好干。”他站起身，走到蓄水池。七月份的天气，里面积留的雨水早就被晒干了，里面只剩下了干裂的土地，还有一些干枯的杂草和树枝。等清理完这些，就能引水过来将丑丑鱼放在里面了。择日不如撞日，他顺着台阶走下河道，开始了清理。因为要供养整个农场，所以蓄水池还是挺大的，清理起来也比较繁琐。因为是新的开始，林枫也没觉得累，很快，里面的杂草树枝就被他提了上来，放在路旁。
content_en:
[Congratulations to the host for increasing the happiness value of the Vine Snake from 10% to 30%, and will be rewarded with ten bags of golden candies and a magical candy.Special scale fruit (can permanently and effectively improve the special attack of Pokémon.)] "Is it delicious?" Seeing the joy radiating from it and listening to the system's announcement, Lin Feng asked knowingly."Teng Teng..." Teng Teng Snake's bright eyes became even brighter, and he nodded his head quickly. However, he felt that it was too obvious, so he lowered the frequency of nodding and closed his eyes."Just eat it if you like. I will keep providing energy cubes like this until we finish weeding." Seeing such a vine snake, Lin Feng couldn't help but feel happy.This guy obviously likes to eat, but he still pretends to be reserved... His head is slightly lowered, his orange eyes are somewhat evasive... This look... is really... a bit cute?"Well, during the weeding period, your food will be this energy cube." "Vine?" The Vine Snake looked at the energy cube placed on the ground, and then at the weeds that had been pulled out on the ground. The movements of its hands suddenly slowed down.After pulling the grass, there will be no more energy cubes?But...it can pull out all these grasses in one day!No, you have to go slower...otherwise, how can you stay longer?Thinking this way, it even slowed down the speed of eating energy cubes.It took half an hour to finish eating, and then devoted himself to the business of pulling weeds, but the efficiency of pulling weeds this time... Lin Feng almost wanted to laugh when he saw it, but he still defended it: "If you want to practice pulling weeds, you can actually use a cane whip to pull weeds. This will make you more proficient in mastering the whip on your body." "For example, the strength and accuracy of the cane whip can be strengthened in this kind of training." He was not talking nonsense.With god-level training knowledge, the training methods he set up were very effective."Tengteng?" Tengteng Snake stood up, looked at Lin Feng with bright eyes, and couldn't help but nodded.This human being is so smart!You can actually think of such a method!"Teng Teng~"

(It makes sense~) Not only can you train the vine whip, but it can also slow down your weeding speed!Its two vine whips began to stretch toward the ground next to it. "Hey..." Lin Feng couldn't help but laugh when he saw this, and began to pull out grass. He wanted to clear a piece of land today, and at least, plant some emergency plants, such as plants configured as good wound medicine, and some products that could prepare simple energy cubes.He pulled weeds very quickly. In just ten minutes, he had already pulled out almost half of the land."Vine and vine..." This makes the vine and vine snake next to it very anxious. Don't pull it out so fast!Slow down~ If I pull it out so fast, wouldn’t I be able to eat the energy cubes?But Lin Feng still went his own way and continued to pull out. Soon, the first piece of land was at its end, and the weeds on it were all gone.For the rest, you only need to use the pangolin kid to plow the entire land and plant it."Teng Teng..." At this time, Teng Teng Snake grabbed his trousers with a vine whip."What's wrong? Vine Snake?" Lin Feng turned around curiously."Teng Teng...Teng Teng~" (This... pulled weeds... I ate your Taotao fruit, so... this... should be what I did...) Its words were a bit messy, but he still understood the meaning.Probably, this is my job, you don’t need to do it."Yes..." Lin Feng laughed dumbly. He squatted down and looked at the vine snake, which was only 80 centimeters tall. He subconsciously wanted to put his hand on its head, but the latter easily dodged it.Lin Feng was not annoyed, "Okay, then do your best." He stood up and walked to the reservoir.In the July weather, the rainwater accumulated inside had long since dried up, leaving only cracked earth and some dry weeds and branches inside.After cleaning these, we can bring water over and put the ugly fish inside.Rather than choosing a good day, he walked down the steps to the river and started cleaning up.Because it has to support the entire farm, the reservoir is quite large and cleaning it is quite tedious.Because it was a new beginning, Lin Feng didn't feel tired. Soon, he picked up the weeds and branches inside and placed them on the roadside.
